title: Climate-Gated Nitrogen Export: corrected code and data for an equal-effort timing analysis in Iowa
description: Corrected reproducibility archive for Soetan and Kaleita, 'Climate-Gated Nitrogen Export: An Equal-Effort Analysis of Nitrogen-Surplus Reduction Timing in Iowa.' The release contains the 1,750-row complete-case county-year model frame for 98 Iowa counties during 2001-2019, portable analysis code, manuscript figures, machine-readable results, and robustness outputs. The primary counterfactual restricts reductions to positive surplus and sets negative modeled marginal responses to zero.
